# SARIF 2.1.0 schema (vendored for tests)

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the official JSON schema for SARIF 2.1.0 (errata 01), copied
unchanged so the SARIF report tests validate offline.

- **Source:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/main/sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json
- **Upstream repository:** https://github.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec (commit `a560296ca8c921f3bdb8d4a8db57ab83dae968a7`, 2024-05-02)
- **Schema id:** `https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json`
- **Version:** SARIF 2.1.0, JSON Schema draft-04
- **Downloaded:** 2026-09-28
